event: A broad regex query was accidentally run over all 11,000 rows in the existing fresh-inventory.json. containment: No further global searches were run. The broad query output was not used for semantic judgments; relevant same-topic cards were read directly. Existing inventory and raw source captures remain unmodified.
disposition: HOLD pending coordinator review of the read-scope deviation; no quality credit claimed.
